fantrax_getleagueinfo_missing_league_id..note: Returned with HTTP status 200. A client that trusts the status code parses this error envelope as data.

fantrax_getleagueinfo_settings_sanitized.note: Identity-bearing sections were removed whole. No retained source value was edited. The endpoint succeeded without userSecretId.

fantrax_getplayerids_nba.json.note: Committed in full. The whole point of this fixture is the row mix — player rows alongside the 30 team entities that risk R24 is about — so trimming it would remove the thing it exists to test.

nba_boxscoresummaryv3_0022400633_reconci.note: Independent home/away anchor for the repeated-canonical LeagueGameFinder matchup fixture.

nba_boxscoresummaryv3_0022500560_midseas.note: Inactive lists live under homeTeam.inactives / awayTeam.inactives. BoxScoreSummaryV2 returns an empty InactivePlayers table for this game; V3 returns the real one.

nba_commonallplayers_current.json.note: Current-season rosters, which is what the crosswalk must match against. Matching against a historical season manufactures a team disagreement for every player who moved in the offseason.

nba_injury_report_2025-11-01_0530pm.pdf.note: Real captured report, committed whole rather than trimmed: it is a 7-page PDF (~79KB) and the parser's row-boundary logic depends on the full multi-page, multi-matchup, multi-line-reason and page-footer structure, including a same-team 'NOT YET SUBMITTED' marker row for two teams whose report had not been filed as of this capture.

nba_leaguegamefinder_playoffs.json.note: Whole real rows retained as complete playoff game groups. No value edited.

nba_leaguegamefinder_reconciliation.json.note: Whole real rows retained for one ordinary reciprocal game and one game where both team rows repeat the same canonical MATCHUP. No value edited.

nba_leaguegamefinder_trimmed.json.note: Whole rows removed; only complete two-row game groups are retained. Required cross-endpoint game 0022400306 is included. No value edited.

nba_playergamelogs_trimmed.json.note: Whole rows removed from the end. No value edited.

nba_scheduleleaguev2_2026_27.json.note: Recorded slice preserves resolved games, two unresolved NBA Cup games, and October/March time-zone transitions. Source has 1,206 regular-season entries: 1,200 resolved games plus six TBD games.

nba_scheduleleaguev2_2026_27_gamedates.j.note: A dates-only calendar, not a trimmed slice of game objects like nba_scheduleleaguev2_2026_27.json above: every gameDate is kept, but each is reduced to just its date string, with no game/team/player identities. Built for the injury-report current-season live-smoke probe (test_live_smoke.py::TestInjuryReportCurrentSeasonIsAlive) to select a recent, independently game-backed candidate date without guessing a calendar date has a game -- the three sparse anchors in nba_scheduleleaguev2_2026_27.json produced gaps up to ~100 days, far too coarse for that purpose. The 13 preseason-only dates (every game that day labelled gameLabel == 'Preseason') are deliberately excluded: the injury-report adapter is out of scope before the season's first game (R40, docs/backlog.md). The largest gap among the 160 kept regular-season dates is 7 days (2027-02-18 -> 2027-02-25, the All-Star break).

nba_static_teams.json.note: Packaged with nba_api; no network call.
